The '''Enderman Mask''' is an {{Uncommon}} [[Helmet]] received from the [[End Race]].

== Obtaining ==
=== End Race ===
The '''Enderman Mask''' is given by {{NPCSprite|Guber}} when the [[End Race]] is completed in under {{Green|2 minutes}}. Afterwards, it can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Rusty}} for {{c|1k}}.

== Trivia ==
*If you wear this mask and an item that reduces your {{Stat|mana}} below 1, you can infinitely spam the {{Item|Jingle Bells}} and [[Power Orbs]]. Please note this has no practical use and should only be done as a joke.
*By adding {{Ench|Wisdom V}} to the mask, equipping the mask will allow you to gain {{Stat|mana}}.
*By combining this helmet with other items such as the {{Item|Jerry Pet}}, it is possible to gain a negative amount of {{Stat|Int}}.
